generate_build_yaml: run the script to generate YAML build configuration for all gRPC end-to-end tests
check_fixture_test_compatibility: use the compatible function to check if a given fixture and test are compatible with each other
review_fixture_options: review the FixtureOptions namedtuple to understand available configuration fields for gRPC test fixtures
review_test_options: review the TestOptions namedtuple to understand available configuration fields for gRPC end-to-end tests
summarize_end2end_fixtures: summarize the END2END_FIXTURES dictionary to see all defined test fixtures and their options
